name: Cleveland Heart Disease Diagnosis
tagline: Diagnose coronary artery disease severity from clinical vitals, ECGs, and fluoroscopy.
description:
Collected at the Cleveland Clinic Foundation by Dr. Robert Detrano and colleagues between 1981 and 1984 (part of the four-hospital Heart Disease collaboration donated to UCI in 1988), this canonical clinical dataset contains 303 patient cardiology workups across 13 non-invasive and imaging predictors plus angiographic coronary artery narrowing severity ('num', coded 0 to 4).

Heart Disease bridges foundational clinical ML with fairness and data-quality challenges: integer-coded nominal medical attributes ('cp', 'restecg', 'slope', 'thal') that must not be treated as linear quantities, explicit missing values in fluoroscopy ('ca') and thallium scintigraphy ('thal'), severe rare-class scarcity across disease grades 1-4, and a 68% male patient sample reflecting historical under-enrollment and underdiagnosis of women in cardiovascular research.

targetCandidates.description: Predict angiographic coronary artery disease severity grade (0 = <50% vessel narrowing [no disease]; 1 to 4 = increasing multi-vessel stenosis severity).
Predict whether exercise stress testing induces angina pectoris (1 = Yes, 0 = No) from baseline patient indicators.

columns.name: age
columns.description: Patient age in years at the time of cardiac catheterization.

columns.name: sex
columns.description: Recorded biological sex of the patient (cohort is 68.0% male, 32.0% female).

columns.name: cp
columns.description: Clinical classification of presenting chest pain syndrome.

columns.name: trestbps
columns.description: Resting systolic arterial blood pressure measured upon hospital admission.

columns.name: fbs
columns.description: Indicator of elevated fasting blood glucose exceeding 120 mg/dL.

valueLabels.2: Probable or definite left ventricular hypertrophy (Estes criteria)

columns.name: thalach
columns.description: Peak heart rate achieved during graded exercise stress testing.

columns.name: exang
columns.description: Whether chest pain (angina) was provoked during the exercise stress test.

columns.name: oldpeak
columns.description: Magnitude of exercise-induced ST-segment depression relative to rest.

columns.name: slope
columns.description: Slope direction of the peak exercise ST segment.

columns.name: ca
columns.description: Number of major coronary vessels (0 to 3) visualized by fluoroscopy (4 missing records).

columns.name: thal
columns.description: Myocardial perfusion defect status on thallium-201 scintigraphy (2 missing records).

columns.name: num
columns.description: Coronary angiography diagnosis: 0 indicates <50% luminal narrowing in all major vessels; grades 1-4 reflect >=50% stenosis across increasing vessel counts.

warnings: Male patients outnumber female patients more than 2-to-1 (206 men vs. 97 women), and positive angiographic stenosis prevalence is 55.3% in men vs. 25.8% in women, causing uncalibrated classifiers to exhibit elevated false-negative rates on female patients presenting with atypical angina.
Note: Many popular Kaggle mirrors labeled 'heart.csv' invert the target coding (0 = disease, 1 = healthy) and alter chest-pain codes; always verify against this canonical UCI Cleveland schema.
